why: Slice 0008 forbids a list of change categories outright. Each is checked against the base here rather than asserted in prose, so a violation is a failing row and not a missing sentence.

checks.name: central pin file changes exactly two lines
no target framework changed in any project or props file
no warning suppression or vulnerability suppression introduced
no VersionOverride in any project or props file
checks.note: Scoped deliberately. An unscoped grep also matches this work package's own evidence prose, where the word appears because the option was considered and rejected — which is a statement about the decision, not a use of the attribute.

headBinding: Deliberately not recorded here. A file cannot carry the hash of the tree that contains it, and an earlier version of this file named a candidate that was later rewritten -- which is exactly the staleness it would invite. The commit and tree of the candidate are bound by the freeze record, which lives outside the tree it names.
